badDaM mumoca vinadantaM prasahya; sudarSanIyaM devatAnAM lalAmam
bandeH samAdeSakarA vayaM sma; niboDa vAkyaM ca mayeryamARam
balaM tvAsIddvApare pArTa kfzRaH; kalAvaDarmaH kzitimAjagAma
balaM Srotre vANmanaScakzuzI ca; jYAnaM taTA na viSudDaM mamAdya
balAnniyukto DftarAzwreRa rAjYA; manIziRAM pARqavAnAM sakASam
baliM ca viprAya ca dehi BikzAm
balirhi rAjA pAramavindamAno; nAnyatkAlAtkAraRaM tatra mene
balena tulyo yasya pumAnna vidyate; gadABftAmagrya ihArimardanaH
bahu vittaM pARqavAMScejjayestvaM; kiM tena syAdvasu vindeha pArTAn
bahuSrutyA guruSuSrUzayA vA; parasya vA saMhananAdvadanti
bARena bARena mahAraTAnAM; cicCeda cApAni raRe prasahya
bAlezu putrezu kfpaRaM vadatsu; taTA vAcamavacinvanti santaH
bAlo'pi vipro mAnya eveha rAjYAM; yaScAvidvAnyaSca vidvAnyaTAvat
bAlo'bAlaH sTaviro vA ripuryaH; sadA pramattaM puruzaM nihanyAt
bAlo vAkyaM sTavira iva praBAzate; nAyaM bAlaH sTaviro'yaM mato me
bAhuByAM vAca udarAdupasTAt; tezAM dvAraM dvArapAlo buBUzet
bAhU diDakzanvAritaH Palgunena; kiM duzkftaM BIma tadABavizyat
biBarti devIM SirasA mahImimAM; samudranemiM parigfhya sarvataH
biBezi cettvamaDarmAnnarendra; prayacCa me SIGramevAdya vAmyO
budDirdIptA balavantaM hinasti; balaM budDyA varDate pAlyamAnam
budDyAtmake vyastamastIti tuzwo; mohAdekatvaM yaTA carma cakzuH
budDyA BaktyA cottamaSradDayA ca; tataste'haM dadmi varaM yaTezwam
budDyA samo yasya naro na vidyate; vaktA taTA satsu viniScayajYaH
buDyAmi tvAM vftrahaRaM SatakratuM; vyatikramantaM BuvanAni viSvA
buBukzavaH SucikAmA hi devA; nASraddaDAnAdDi havirjuzanti
bfhannaqA sAraTiScennarendra; pare na nezyanti tavAdya gAstAH
bfhaspatiM tvamupaSikzasva rAjan; vajraM vA te praharizyAmi Goram
bfhaspatiM devaguruM surAsurAH; sametya sarve nfpate'nvayuYjan
bfhaspatiM yAjakaM tvaM vfRIzva; vajraM vA te praharizyAmi Goram
bravIti taccAmuta viprapUrvAt; taccApi sarvaM mama duryoDane'sti
bravImi satyaM kurusaMsadIha; tavEva tA BArata paYca nadyaH
brahmakzatraM vESyavarRaM ca SUdraH; krameREtAnnyAyataH pUjayAnaH
brahmacaryaM vedavidyAH kriyASca; nizevamARA munayo'mutra BAnti
brahmansa tenAcarate brahmahatyAM; lokAstasya hyantavanto Bavanti
brahma yattaM nivasati dehavatsu; tasmAdvidyAdvyavasAyaM praBUtam
brahmEva vidvAMstena aByeti sarvaM; nAnyaH panTA ayanAya vidyate
brAhmaRasya hi yAjanaM viDIyate na kzatravESyayordvijAtyoH
brAhmaRAnAM hastiBirnAsti kftyaM; rAjanyAnAM nAgakulAni vipra
brAhmaReByo mfgayantI sUnftAni; taTA brahmanpuRyalokaM laBeyam
brAhmaM pAYcAlAH kOraveyAH svaDarmaH; satyaM matsyAH SUrasenASca yajYaH
brAhmaM vrataM nityamAsTAya vidDi; na tvevAhaM tasya PalAdihAgAm
brAhmIM mAyAmAsurI cEva mAyA; tvayi sTite kaTamevAtivartet
brUyAcca mA pravfRIzveti loke; yudDe'dvitIyaM sacivaM raTasTam
